elements.title: Formulas for variance

nodes: Sample variance formula: s² = Σ(x - x̄)² / (n - 1)
Population variance formula: σ² = Σ(x - μ)² / N
Alternate formula for variance: σ² = Σx² / N - μ²
connections: Sample variance formula and Population variance formula are related formulas for variance calculation
Alternate formula is an alternative computation method for variance

elements.summary: This element shows the mathematical formulas for calculating sample variance, population variance, and an alternate formula for variance, explaining the components and differences in denominators.
